nodes.title: Still do frame-guia 2 — MUDO na versão longa
Prompt v15 — fundo trocado em TODOS os frames
widgets_values:
Replace the entire background and environment of <Video 1> with the tropical jungle of <Picture 1>, in every frame of the video, from the first frame to the last. The room, the walls, the shelves, the books, the ceiling, the lamps, the furniture and every object of the original room must never appear; there is no room, only the jungle.

Keep only the person from <Video 1>: his identity, face, glasses, hair, beard, clothing, body, poses, gestures, hand movements, expressions and lip movements, exactly as in <Video 1>. Keep the camera movement, framing, perspective and timing of <Video 1>.

The jungle of <Picture 1>: dense tropical forest, large green leaves, palms, hanging vines, tall trees, warm orange sunlight and god rays through the canopy, soft haze in the air. As the camera moves, reveal more of the same jungle behind and around the person, consistent from frame to frame. Light the person with the warm sunlight of the jungle.

Use <Picture 1> as the reference for the environment, mood, lighting, color palette and atmosphere. Do not copy the composition, pose or camera angle of <Picture 1>.

Maintain the same jungle, lighting and color grading throughout the entire video. The result should look as if <Video 1> was filmed in the jungle of <Picture 1> from the beginning.

nodes.title: LEIA-ME (PT) — v16 vídeo longo com SyncTile (bruxosdovfx)
widgets_values:
bruxosdovfx • MiniMax H3 Character/Background Swap — VÍDEO LONGO com SyncTile (v18 + carry)

O QUE FAZ
Troca o fundo/personagem de um vídeo seu (ref2va) e entrega até 4K, em vídeos longos (testado no plano de 600 frames = 25 s).
Estágio 1: gera em ~0,5 MP, em JANELAS de 124 frames que se misturam a cada passo (VRAM = uma janela).
Estágio 2: amplia o latent (upscaler 3D) e refina com SyncTile: tiles no espaço x janelas no tempo.
Saída: decode em streaming (bloco a bloco) → arquivo + IMAGE para o 🧙 Save Video Pro.

━━━━━━━━ INSTALAÇÃO ━━━━━━━━
Custom nodes:
• bruxosdovfx-SyncTile 5.5 (zip) → ComfyUI/custom_nodes/bruxosdovfx-SyncTile. APAGUE ComfyUI-SyncTile-H3 se existir. O console mostra "[bruxosdovfx • SyncTile] v5.5 carregado".
• Latent upscaler 3D: https://github.com/LBH-123-AI/Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler
• Nodes Bruxos (Load Video Pro, Load Image, Save Video Pro).
• ffmpeg (para o arquivo): já vem com a maioria das instalações; se não, no Python do ComfyUI: pip install imageio-ffmpeg

Modelos (pasta → arquivo → download):
• models/diffusion_models/Minimax/ → minimax_h3_fused_refdelta_r1024_turbo8_mystic07_int8_convrot.safetensors (21 GB; H3 fused ref2va+fl2va, turbo 4 passos)
  https://huggingface.co/MATLOWAI/minimax-h3-fused-turbo-int8-convrot/blob/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fused_refdelta_r1024_turbo8_mystic07_int8_convrot.safetensors
• models/text_encoders/ → qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors (27 GB)
  https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors
  (menos RAM: qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors, 15,7 GB, mesma pasta do repositório)
• models/vae/Minimax/ → minimax_h3_lynnreal_light_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors (VAE de vídeo leve, rápido)
  https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental/blob/main/minimax_h3_lynnreal_light_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors
  (mais detalhe/menos textura falsa: minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot ou _fp16 em https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/tree/main/vae)
• models/vae/Minimax/ → minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
  https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
• models/latent_upscale_models/ → minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_conv_v1_bf16.safetensors
  https://huggingface.co/LBH-123-AI/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler/tree/main/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_conv_v1
• LoRAs: as duas pilhas estão DESLIGADAS neste workflow (o modelo fused já tem o turbo). Opcionais.
  LoRAs do workflow: pilha 1 = minimax_h3_pdmd_4step_lora_avg_rank_57_bf16 (1.0, Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental › loras; só com modelo NÃO turbo) + Background Replace v3 (1.0); pilha 2 = minimax_h3_lms_v1.0_r64 (0.3, Alissonerdx/Minimax-H3-ComfyUI › loras; nitidez).
  Background Replace v3 (mescla de 5 LoRAs de outros autores, BF16 1,9 GB): força 1.0; download: huggingface.co/NyckM/Background_Replace_Minimax_H3 ; créditos no README. Ainda não testada em geração.
• Passe o mouse sobre qualquer entrada dos nodes SyncTile: explicação em PT / EN / 中文.

━━━━━━━━ COMO USAR ━━━━━━━━
1. User Inputs: escolha o vídeo no 🧙 Load Video Pro (em 24 fps! o H3 é 24 fps) e a foto de referência no Load Image.
2. Prompt: descreva o que trocar e o que manter (veja o exemplo; diga "em todos os frames").
3. Run. Saída em output/ (Save Video Pro) e cópia h265 em output/SyncTile/.

FRAMES-GUIA (segurar o fundo no vídeo todo)
• A foto do Load Image já é o guia 1 (frame 1).
• Para mais: grupo azul "Frames-guia extras" (mudo). Carregue um still em cada Guia, Ctrl+M no grupo, e escreva os frames em guide_frames no node "Estagio 1", na mesma ordem (ex.: 100, 220, 340, 460). Nº de imagens = nº de frames.
• Cada still = aquele frame do vídeo fonte com o fundo trocado (mesmo enquadramento). Um a cada ~4-5 s cobre todas as janelas.

━━━━━━━━ O QUE PODE AJUSTAR ━━━━━━━━
• Prompt e foto de referência.
• Duração: frames no Load Video Pro (grade do H3 17n+5: 124, 243, 362, 600…).
• Resolução do estágio 1: megapixels no seletor (0,5 = padrão; 0,7 mais detalhe/mais VRAM).
• Tamanho final: megapixels do latent upscaler no Estagio 2 (6 ≈ 2208x2848 retrato; 8 ≈ 4K).
• Janelas (nos DOIS nodes de conditioning, valores iguais): window_frames 124 (107/90 se faltar VRAM) e window_overlap_frames 39 (56/73 se houver costura ou cintilação; mais lento).
• Frames-guia: guide_frame_1 / guide_images + guide_frames.
• Força do refino 4K: sigmas do Estagio 2. Padrão 0.878, 0.8, 0.6316, 0. Mais fiel/menos detalhe: 0.8, 0.6316, 0.
• Variar só o refino: no SyncTile Guider do Estagio 2, use_refine_seed = true e mude refine_seed (o estágio 1 fica em cache).
• Saída: codec (h265 10-bit / h264 / ProRes 422 HQ), crf (menor = melhor), image_output (full / half / off) e write_video.

━━━━━━━━ NÃO MEXA (a menos que saiba o porquê) ━━━━━━━━
• tile 4096x4096 no Estagio 1: significa "sem tiles no espaço" (o estágio 1 só divide no tempo). Não é erro.
• tile 1472x896 no Estagio 2: só baixe para 1216x704 se faltar VRAM — e igual no Guider e no Conditioning.
• min_overlap 16, sync_mode "per model call", cfg 1.0 (modelo turbo, sem CFG).
• Passos/sigmas do estágio 1 (4 passos, SplitSigmas): é o que o modelo turbo espera.
• length / width / height dos nodes SyncTile: vêm do latent e do Load Video Pro automaticamente.
• fps 24 no decode (o H3 gera a 24 fps).
• Ligações de latent (Separate/Concat AV, upscaler): a ordem importa.

━━━━━━━━ PROBLEMAS COMUNS ━━━━━━━━
• Fundo volta ao original no meio do vídeo → prompt mais explícito, overlap 56/73, ou frames-guia ao longo do vídeo.
• Personagem repetido em 4K → sigmas mais leves no Estagio 2 (0.8, 0.6316, 0).
• Movimento acelerado/áudio fora de sincronia → vídeo fonte não está em 24 fps.
• Erro do ffmpeg → o node mostra a mensagem; sem libx265 ele grava h264 sozinho.
• Pouca RAM no IMAGE → o node cai para meia resolução e avisa; o arquivo h265 é gravado mesmo assim.

ÁUDIO / LIP SYNC (v17)
• O áudio do Load Video Pro agora entra como ref_video_audio_0 nos DOIS conditionings: o modelo ouve a fala e sincroniza a boca. Ele é fatiado por janela junto com o vídeo.
• O arquivo final usa o áudio original (não o áudio gerado).

CARRY (v18) — fim do fantasma nas transições
• SyncTile Guider (Estagio 1 e 2): temporal_mode = carry previous frames. As janelas rodam uma depois da outra e o começo de cada janela fica preso aos últimos 21 frames prontos da anterior (carry_frames). O modelo enxerga esses frames e continua o movimento e o fundo a partir deles.
• Ainda com transição visível: carry_frames 25 ou 33 e window_overlap_frames 56 (nos conditionings).
• Para voltar ao modo antigo: blend windows (joint).

INSTALAÇÃO FÁCIL: bruxosdovfx_EasyInstall_MiniMaxH3.bat na pasta do ComfyUI → dois cliques (pula o que já existe).

v21a_guiaFrameAnterior = configuração do melhor resultado (teste_v003): modo guide from previous window (1 frame anterior como guia), COM áudio do vídeo fonte no conditioning (ref_video_audio_0, lip sync), prompt v15, guia no frame 0, force_rate 24. Estágio 2 guiado pela base decodificada do estágio 1.

nodes.title: README (EN) — v16 long video with SyncTile (bruxosdovfx)
widgets_values:
bruxosdovfx • MiniMax H3 Character/Background Swap — LONG VIDEO with SyncTile (v18 + carry)

WHAT IT DOES
Swaps the background/character of your own video (ref2va) and delivers up to 4K, on long videos (tested on a 600-frame shot = 25 s).
Stage 1: generates at ~0.5 MP in 124-frame WINDOWS blended at every step (VRAM = one window).
Stage 2: enlarges the latent (3D upscaler) and refines with SyncTile: spatial tiles x temporal windows.
Output: streaming decode (block by block) → file + IMAGE for 🧙 Save Video Pro.

━━━━━━━━ INSTALL ━━━━━━━━
Custom nodes:
• bruxosdovfx-SyncTile 5.5 (zip) → ComfyUI/custom_nodes/bruxosdovfx-SyncTile. DELETE ComfyUI-SyncTile-H3 if present. The console shows "[bruxosdovfx • SyncTile] v5.5 carregado".
• 3D latent upscaler: https://github.com/LBH-123-AI/Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler
• Bruxos nodes (Load Video Pro, Load Image, Save Video Pro).
• ffmpeg (for the file): most installs have it; otherwise, in ComfyUI's Python: pip install imageio-ffmpeg

Models (folder → file → download):
• models/diffusion_models/Minimax/ → minimax_h3_fused_refdelta_r1024_turbo8_mystic07_int8_convrot.safetensors (21 GB; H3 fused ref2va+fl2va, turbo 4 steps)
  https://huggingface.co/MATLOWAI/minimax-h3-fused-turbo-int8-convrot/blob/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fused_refdelta_r1024_turbo8_mystic07_int8_convrot.safetensors
• models/text_encoders/ → qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors (27 GB)

  (less RAM: qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors, 15.7 GB, same repo folder)
• models/vae/Minimax/ → minimax_h3_lynnreal_light_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors (light, fast video VAE)
  https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental/blob/main/minimax_h3_lynnreal_light_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors
  (more detail/less fake texture: minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot or _fp16 at https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/tree/main/vae)
• models/vae/Minimax/ → minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
  https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
• models/latent_upscale_models/ → minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_conv_v1_bf16.safetensors
  https://huggingface.co/LBH-123-AI/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler/tree/main/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_conv_v1
• LoRAs: both stacks are OFF in this workflow (the fused model already includes turbo). Optional.
  Workflow LoRAs: stack 1 = minimax_h3_pdmd_4step_lora_avg_rank_57_bf16 (1.0, Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental › loras; only with a NON-turbo model) + Background Replace v3 (1.0); stack 2 = minimax_h3_lms_v1.0_r64 (0.3, Alissonerdx/Minimax-H3-ComfyUI › loras; sharpness).
  Background Replace v3 (merge of 5 LoRAs by other authors, BF16 1.9 GB): strength 1.0; download: huggingface.co/NyckM/Background_Replace_Minimax_H3 ; credits in the README. Not yet tested in generation.
• Hover over any input of the SyncTile nodes: explanation in PT / EN / 中文.

━━━━━━━━ HOW TO USE ━━━━━━━━
1. User Inputs: pick the video in 🧙 Load Video Pro (at 24 fps! H3 is 24 fps) and the reference photo in Load Image.
2. Prompt: describe what to change and what to keep (see the example; say "in every frame").
3. Run. Output in output/ (Save Video Pro) and an h265 copy in output/SyncTile/.

FRAME GUIDES (hold the background through the whole video)
• The Load Image photo is already guide 1 (frame 1).
• For more: blue group "Frames-guia extras" (muted). Load a still in each Guide, Ctrl+M on the group, and type the frames in guide_frames on the "Estagio 1" node, in the same order (e.g. 100, 220, 340, 460). Number of images = number of frames.
• Each still = that frame of the source video with the background already swapped (same framing). One every ~4-5 s covers all windows.

━━━━━━━━ WHAT YOU CAN TUNE ━━━━━━━━
• Prompt and reference photo.
• Length: frames in Load Video Pro (H3 grid 17n+5: 124, 243, 362, 600…).
• Stage-1 resolution: megapixels in the selector (0.5 = default; 0.7 more detail/more VRAM).
• Final size: latent upscaler megapixels in Estagio 2 (6 ≈ 2208x2848 portrait; 8 ≈ 4K).
• Windows (on BOTH conditioning nodes, same values): window_frames 124 (107/90 if out of VRAM) and window_overlap_frames 39 (56/73 for seams or flicker; slower).
• Frame guides: guide_frame_1 / guide_images + guide_frames.
• 4K refine strength: Estagio 2 sigmas. Default 0.878, 0.8, 0.6316, 0. More faithful/less detail: 0.8, 0.6316, 0.
• Vary only the refine: on the Estagio 2 SyncTile Guider, use_refine_seed = true and change refine_seed (stage 1 stays cached).
• Output: codec (h265 10-bit / h264 / ProRes 422 HQ), crf (lower = better), image_output (full / half / off) and write_video.

━━━━━━━━ DON'T TOUCH (unless you know why) ━━━━━━━━
• tile 4096x4096 in Estagio 1: means "no spatial tiles" (stage 1 only splits in time). Not a mistake.
• tile 1472x896 in Estagio 2: lower to 1216x704 only if out of VRAM — and the same on Guider and Conditioning.
• min_overlap 16, sync_mode "per model call", cfg 1.0 (turbo model, no CFG).
• Stage-1 steps/sigmas (4 steps, SplitSigmas): what the turbo model expects.
• length / width / height on the SyncTile nodes: they come from the latent and Load Video Pro automatically.
• fps 24 on the decode (H3 generates at 24 fps).
• Latent links (Separate/Concat AV, upscaler): the order matters.

━━━━━━━━ COMMON PROBLEMS ━━━━━━━━
• Background reverts to the original mid-video → more explicit prompt, overlap 56/73, or frame guides along the video.
• Repeated character at 4K → lighter Estagio 2 sigmas (0.8, 0.6316, 0).
• Sped-up motion/audio out of sync → source video is not 24 fps.
• ffmpeg error → the node shows the message; without libx265 it writes h264 by itself.
• Low RAM for IMAGE → the node drops to half resolution and says so; the h265 file is written anyway.

AUDIO / LIP SYNC (v17)
• The Load Video Pro audio now goes in as ref_video_audio_0 on BOTH conditioning nodes: the model hears the speech and syncs the mouth. It is sliced per window together with the video.
• The final file uses the original audio (not the generated audio).

CARRY (v18) — no more ghosting at the joins
• SyncTile Guider (Estagio 1 and 2): temporal_mode = carry previous frames. Windows run one after another and the start of each window is locked to the last 21 finished frames of the previous one (carry_frames). The model sees those frames and continues the motion and background from them.
• Join still visible: carry_frames 25 or 33 and window_overlap_frames 56 (on the conditioning nodes).
• Back to the old mode: blend windows (joint).

EASY INSTALL: bruxosdovfx_EasyInstall_MiniMaxH3.bat in the ComfyUI folder → double-click (skips what is already there).

v21a_guiaFrameAnterior = settings of the best result (teste_v003): guide from previous window (previous frame as guide) mode, WITH the source audio in the conditioning (ref_video_audio_0, lip sync), prompt v15, guide at frame 0, force_rate 24. Stage 2 guided by the decoded stage-1 base.

nodes.title: 说明 (中文) — v16 SyncTile 长视频 (bruxosdovfx)
widgets_values:
bruxosdovfx • MiniMax H3 人物/背景替换 — 使用 SyncTile 的长视频（v16）

功能
替换你自己视频中的背景/人物（ref2va），输出最高 4K，支持长视频（已在 600 帧 = 25 秒的镜头上测试）。
第一阶段：约 0.5 MP，按 124 帧的窗口生成，每一步都融合（显存 = 一个窗口）。
第二阶段：放大潜变量（3D 放大器），再用 SyncTile 精修：空间图块 x 时间窗口。
输出：流式解码（逐块）→ 文件 + IMAGE 给 🧙 Save Video Pro。

━━━━━━━━ 安装 ━━━━━━━━
自定义节点：
• bruxosdovfx-SyncTile 5.5（zip）→ ComfyUI/custom_nodes/bruxosdovfx-SyncTile。如有 ComfyUI-SyncTile-H3 请删除。控制台显示 "[bruxosdovfx • SyncTile] v5.5 carregado"。
• 3D 潜空间放大器：https://github.com/LBH-123-AI/Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler
• Bruxos 节点（Load Video Pro、Load Image、Save Video Pro）。
• ffmpeg（写出文件用）：大多数安装已自带；否则在 ComfyUI 的 Python 中运行：pip install imageio-ffmpeg

模型（文件夹 → 文件 → 下载）：
• models/diffusion_models/Minimax/ → minimax_h3_fused_refdelta_r1024_turbo8_mystic07_int8_convrot.safetensors（21 GB；H3 融合 ref2va+fl2va，turbo 4 步）
  https://huggingface.co/MATLOWAI/minimax-h3-fused-turbo-int8-convrot/blob/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fused_refdelta_r1024_turbo8_mystic07_int8_convrot.safetensors
• models/text_encoders/ → qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors（27 GB）
  https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors
  （更省内存：qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors，15.7 GB，同一仓库文件夹）
• models/vae/Minimax/ → minimax_h3_lynnreal_light_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors（轻量、快速的视频 VAE）
  https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental/blob/main/minimax_h3_lynnreal_light_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors
  （细节更多、假纹理更少：minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot 或 _fp16，见 https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/tree/main/vae）
• models/vae/Minimax/ → minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
  https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
• models/latent_upscale_models/ → minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_conv_v1_bf16.safetensors
  https://huggingface.co/LBH-123-AI/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler/tree/main/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_conv_v1
• LoRA：本工作流中两组 LoRA 均已关闭（融合模型已包含 turbo）。可选。
  工作流 LoRA：第 1 组 = minimax_h3_pdmd_4step_lora_avg_rank_57_bf16（1.0，Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental › loras；仅配合非 turbo 模型）+ Background Replace v3（1.0）；第 2 组 = minimax_h3_lms_v1.0_r64（0.3，Alissonerdx/Minimax-H3-ComfyUI › loras；锐化）。
  Background Replace v3（由其他作者的 5 个 LoRA 合并，BF16 1.9 GB）：强度 1.0；下载：huggingface.co/NyckM/Background_Replace_Minimax_H3；署名见 README。尚未在生成中测试。
• 鼠标悬停在 SyncTile 节点的任意输入上：可查看 PT / EN / 中文 说明。

━━━━━━━━ 使用方法 ━━━━━━━━
1. User Inputs：在 🧙 Load Video Pro 中选择视频（必须 24 fps！H3 为 24 fps），在 Load Image 中选择参考照片。
2. 提示词：描述要替换什么、保留什么（参考示例；写明“每一帧都”）。
3. 运行。输出在 output/（Save Video Pro），h265 副本在 output/SyncTile/。

帧引导（在整段视频中保持背景）
• Load Image 的照片已经是引导 1（第 1 帧）。
• 需要更多：蓝色分组 "Frames-guia extras"（已静音）。在每个 Guia 中加载一张静帧，对分组按 Ctrl+M，然后在 "Estagio 1" 节点的 guide_frames 中按相同顺序填写帧号（例如 100, 220, 340, 460）。图片数量 = 帧号数量。
• 每张静帧 = 源视频中该帧、背景已替换好的画面（构图一致）。每 4-5 秒一张即可覆盖所有窗口。

━━━━━━━━ 可调整 ━━━━━━━━
• 提示词和参考照片。
• 时长：Load Video Pro 中的帧数（H3 网格 17n+5：124、243、362、600…）。
• 第一阶段分辨率：选择器中的百万像素（0.5 = 默认；0.7 细节更多/显存更高）。
• 最终尺寸：Estagio 2 中潜空间放大器的百万像素（6 ≈ 2208x2848 竖版；8 ≈ 4K）。
• 窗口（两个 Conditioning 节点都要改，数值相同）：window_frames 124（显存不足用 107/90），window_overlap_frames 39（有接缝或闪烁用 56/73；更慢）。
• 帧引导：guide_frame_1 / guide_images + guide_frames。
• 4K 精修强度：Estagio 2 的 sigma。默认 0.878, 0.8, 0.6316, 0。更忠实/细节更少：0.8, 0.6316, 0。
• 只改变精修：在 Estagio 2 的 SyncTile Guider 中设 use_refine_seed = true 并修改 refine_seed（第一阶段会被缓存）。
• 输出：codec（h265 10-bit / h264 / ProRes 422 HQ）、crf（越小越好）、image_output（full / half / off）和 write_video。

━━━━━━━━ 不要修改（除非清楚原因）━━━━━━━━
• Estagio 1 的图块 4096x4096：表示“不做空间切分”（第一阶段只在时间上切分），不是错误。
• Estagio 2 的图块 1472x896：只有显存不足时才降到 1216x704，并且 Guider 与 Conditioning 要一致。
• min_overlap 16、sync_mode "per model call"、cfg 1.0（turbo 模型，不用 CFG）。
• 第一阶段的步数/sigma（4 步，SplitSigmas）：turbo 模型需要的设置。
• SyncTile 节点上的 length / width / height：自动来自潜变量和 Load Video Pro。
• 解码的 fps 24（H3 以 24 fps 生成）。
• 潜变量连线（Separate/Concat AV、放大器）：顺序很重要。

━━━━━━━━ 常见问题 ━━━━━━━━
• 视频中途背景变回原样 → 提示词更明确、重叠设为 56/73，或在视频中加帧引导。
• 4K 下人物重复 → Estagio 2 用更轻的 sigma（0.8, 0.6316, 0）。
• 动作变快/音画不同步 → 源视频不是 24 fps。
• ffmpeg 报错 → 节点会显示报错信息；缺少 libx265 时会自动写成 h264。
• IMAGE 内存不足 → 节点会降为半分辨率并提示；h265 文件照常写入。

音频 / 口型同步（v17）
• Load Video Pro 的音频现在作为 ref_video_audio_0 接入两个 Conditioning 节点：模型能听到语音并同步口型。音频会随视频按窗口切片。
• 最终文件使用原始音频（不是生成的音频）。

CARRY（v18）—— 消除衔接处的重影
• SyncTile Guider（Estagio 1 和 2）：temporal_mode = carry previous frames。窗口依次运行，每个窗口的开头锁定为上一个窗口已完成的最后 21 帧（carry_frames）。模型能看到这些帧，并从中延续运动和背景。
• 衔接仍明显：carry_frames 设为 25 或 33，window_overlap_frames 设为 56（在 Conditioning 节点上）。
• 恢复旧模式：blend windows (joint)。

一键安装：把 bruxosdovfx_EasyInstall_MiniMaxH3.bat 放进 ComfyUI 文件夹 → 双击（已存在的会跳过）。

v21a_guiaFrameAnterior = 最佳结果（teste_v003）的设置：guide from previous window（上一帧作为引导） 模式，条件中接入源视频音频（ref_video_audio_0，口型同步），提示词 v15，引导在第 0 帧，force_rate 24。第二阶段以第一阶段解码结果为引导。

自定义节点：
• bruxosdovfx-SyncTile 5.5（zip）→ ComfyUI/custom_nodes/bruxosdovfx-SyncTile。如有 ComfyUI-SyncTile-H3 请删除。控制台显示 "[bruxosdovfx • SyncTile] v5.5 carregado"。
• 3D 潜空间放大器：https://github.com/LBH-123-AI/Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler
• Bruxos 节点（Load Video Pro、Load Image、Save Video Pro）。
• ffmpeg（写出文件用）：大多数安装已自带；否则在 ComfyUI 的 Python 中运行：pip install imageio-ffmpeg

模型（文件夹 → 文件 → 下载）：
• models/diffusion_models/Minimax/ → minimax_h3_fused_refdelta_r1024_turbo8_mystic07_int8_convrot.safetensors（21 GB；H3 融合 ref2va+fl2va，turbo 4 步）
  https://huggingface.co/MATLOWAI/minimax-h3-fused-turbo-int8-convrot/blob/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fused_refdelta_r1024_turbo8_mystic07_int8_convrot.safetensors
• models/text_encoders/ → qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors（27 GB）
  https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors
  （更省内存：qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors，15.7 GB，同一仓库文件夹）
• models/vae/Minimax/ → minimax_h3_lynnreal_light_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors（轻量、快速的视频 VAE）
  https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental/blob/main/minimax_h3_lynnreal_light_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors
  （细节更多、假纹理更少：minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot 或 _fp16，见 https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/tree/main/vae）
• models/vae/Minimax/ → minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
  https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
• models/latent_upscale_models/ → minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_conv_v1_bf16.safetensors
  https://huggingface.co/LBH-123-AI/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler/tree/main/minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_conv_v1
• LoRA：本工作流中两组 LoRA 均已关闭（融合模型已包含 turbo）。可选。
  工作流 LoRA：第 1 组 = minimax_h3_pdmd_4step_lora_avg_rank_57_bf16（1.0，Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental › loras；仅配合非 turbo 模型）+ Background Replace v3（1.0）；第 2 组 = minimax_h3_lms_v1.0_r64（0.3，Alissonerdx/Minimax-H3-ComfyUI › loras；锐化）。
  Background Replace v3（由其他作者的 5 个 LoRA 合并，BF16 1.9 GB）：强度 1.0；下载：huggingface.co/NyckM/Background_Replace_Minimax_H3；署名见 README。尚未在生成中测试。
• 鼠标悬停在 SyncTile 节点的任意输入上：可查看 PT / EN / 中文 说明。

━━━━━━━━ 使用方法 ━━━━━━━━
1. User Inputs：在 🧙 Load Video Pro 中选择视频（必须 24 fps！H3 为 24 fps），在 Load Image 中选择参考照片。
2. 提示词：描述要替换什么、保留什么（参考示例；写明“每一帧都”）。
3. 运行。输出在 output/（Save Video Pro），h265 副本在 output/SyncTile/。

帧引导（在整段视频中保持背景）
• Load Image 的照片已经是引导 1（第 1 帧）。
• 需要更多：蓝色分组 "Frames-guia extras"（已静音）。在每个 Guia 中加载一张静帧，对分组按 Ctrl+M，然后在 "Estagio 1" 节点的 guide_frames 中按相同顺序填写帧号（例如 100, 220, 340, 460）。图片数量 = 帧号数量。
• 每张静帧 = 源视频中该帧、背景已替换好的画面（构图一致）。每 4-5 秒一张即可覆盖所有窗口。

━━━━━━━━ 可调整 ━━━━━━━━
• 提示词和参考照片。
• 时长：Load Video Pro 中的帧数（H3 网格 17n+5：124、243、362、600…）。
• 第一阶段分辨率：选择器中的百万像素（0.5 = 默认；0.7 细节更多/显存更高）。
• 最终尺寸：Estagio 2 中潜空间放大器的百万像素（6 ≈ 2208x2848 竖版；8 ≈ 4K）。
• 窗口（两个 Conditioning 节点都要改，数值相同）：window_frames 124（显存不足用 107/90），window_overlap_frames 39（有接缝或闪烁用 56/73；更慢）。
• 帧引导：guide_frame_1 / guide_images + guide_frames。
• 4K 精修强度：Estagio 2 的 sigma。默认 0.878, 0.8, 0.6316, 0。更忠实/细节更少：0.8, 0.6316, 0。
• 只改变精修：在 Estagio 2 的 SyncTile Guider 中设 use_refine_seed = true 并修改 refine_seed（第一阶段会被缓存）。
• 输出：codec（h265 10-bit / h264 / ProRes 422 HQ）、crf（越小越好）、image_output（full / half / off）和 write_video。

━━━━━━━━ 不要修改（除非清楚原因）━━━━━━━━
• Estagio 1 的图块 4096x4096：表示“不做空间切分”（第一阶段只在时间上切分），不是错误。
• Estagio 2 的图块 1472x896：只有显存不足时才降到 1216x704，并且 Guider 与 Conditioning 要一致。
• min_overlap 16、sync_mode "per model call"、cfg 1.0（turbo 模型，不用 CFG）。
• 第一阶段的步数/sigma（4 步，SplitSigmas）：turbo 模型需要的设置。
• SyncTile 节点上的 length / width / height：自动来自潜变量和 Load Video Pro。
• 解码的 fps 24（H3 以 24 fps 生成）。
• 潜变量连线（Separate/Concat AV、放大器）：顺序很重要。

━━━━━━━━ 常见问题 ━━━━━━━━
• 视频中途背景变回原样 → 提示词更明确、重叠设为 56/73，或在视频中加帧引导。
• 4K 下人物重复 → Estagio 2 用更轻的 sigma（0.8, 0.6316, 0）。
• 动作变快/音画不同步 → 源视频不是 24 fps。
• ffmpeg 报错 → 节点会显示报错信息；缺少 libx265 时会自动写成 h264。
• IMAGE 内存不足 → 节点会降为半分辨率并提示；h265 文件照常写入。

音频 / 口型同步（v17）
• Load Video Pro 的音频现在作为 ref_video_audio_0 接入两个 Conditioning 节点：模型能听到语音并同步口型。音频会随视频按窗口切片。
• 最终文件使用原始音频（不是生成的音频）。

CARRY（v18）—— 消除衔接处的重影
• SyncTile Guider（Estagio 1 和 2）：temporal_mode = carry previous frames。窗口依次运行，每个窗口的开头锁定为上一个窗口已完成的最后 21 帧（carry_frames）。模型能看到这些帧，并从中延续运动和背景。
• 衔接仍明显：carry_frames 设为 25 或 33，window_overlap_frames 设为 56（在 Conditioning 节点上）。
• 恢复旧模式：blend windows (joint)。

一键安装：把 bruxosdovfx_EasyInstall_MiniMaxH3.bat 放进 ComfyUI 文件夹 → 双击（已存在的会跳过）。
